## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Enter Commissions (ACB-3598) › AC08: with a Flexi Rate selected, IC/RC dropped default becomes "Please Select" (fields gated on IC/RC)

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC08: With a FlexiRate selected on the Quote screen, the IC/RC dropdown defaults to "Please Select" and the other commission fields are disabled until an IC/RC value is chosen.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, price Life $200k, set Flexi Rate = 15.0% on the quote screen. 2. Open Adviser Use. 3. Read the IC/RC dropdown default.
> 
> Expected: IC/RC default is "Please Select" (per AC02: "Please Select if flexirate has been selected").

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| IC/RC default with a Flexi Rate selected | Please Select | IC-50%, RC-50% |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC08: IC/RC default Please Select with flexi

expect(received).toMatch(expected)

Expected pattern: /Please Select/i
```

![Enter Commissions (ACB-3598) › AC08: with a Flexi Rate selected, IC/RC dropped default becomes "Please Select" (fields gated on IC/RC)](data:image/png;base64,)

## Skipped / Blocked Tests — Detail

### ⏭️ Enter Commissions (ACB-3598) › AC03/AC04/AC05/AC09/AC10: Default-update confirmation + Select-All + flexi->IC/RC->commission-structure value mappings

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC03: Update Default-for-Agency shows "Your default commission structure setting has been updated". AC04: Select-All applies a structure to all covers. AC05: Premium Structure + SI shown non-editable. AC09/AC10: the exact IC/RC options + commission structures per Flexi Rate (15% -> IC-50/RC-50 etc; 2.5% -> IC-75/RC-100 -> LEVEL 30).

**Why skipped:**

> Deferred: these overlap the already-tested Adviser-Use / Default-Commission-Category area (select-default-commission-category-v1.spec.js), which encodes the flexi->IC/RC->structure mappings AND documents 7 known pre-existing QA regressions there. Re-testing the same value mappings here would duplicate those expected-fails. AC03 Update-default is state-mutating (changes the agency default) and is covered by that spec's save/persistence tests. Encode any NET-NEW commissions-screen-specific behaviour in a focused follow-up once the known commission regressions are resolved, to avoid duplicate red.
